title: Refactor Chatbot Plugin for AI SDUI: Integrate service-ai and vercel/ai SDK
body:
## Background
In preparation for a robust, production-grade AI chatbot experience and aligned with [spec#999](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/issues/999), the Chatbot component in ObjectUI plugin needs to be fully refactored:
- **Backend**: Integrate with the new `service-ai` backend (REST/SSE at /api/v1/ai/chat, etc.), standardizing all AI/LLM access via the platform contract (IAIService).
- **SDK**: Use `vercel/ai` SDK (and `@ai-sdk/react`) as the underlying React/streaming engine for chat. Ensure full support for streaming messages, tool-calling, and future multi-modal extensions.

## Task List / Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Abstract chat state management and streaming using a new composable hook (e.g., `useObjectChat`) built on top of `@ai-sdk/react`'s `useChat`.
- [ ] Extend `ChatbotSchema` and `ChatMessage` types to support new required fields (`api`, `conversationId`, `systemPrompt`, `model`, streaming flags, partials for tool-calling, etc.).
- [ ] Refactor `Chatbot` and `ChatbotEnhanced` to:
  - Be fully controlled by the new hook (rely on server/streaming, not local fake autoReply).
  - Dynamically call the backend SSE API when `api` is set, otherwise fallback to local auto response mode (legacy).
  - Handle streaming state, message appends, errors, and support stop/reload/clear actions.
  - Support tool invocation flows as proposed in the vercel/ai SDK.
- [ ] Update the `renderer.tsx` to auto-detect API mode and wire schema fields accordingly.
- [ ] Maintain complete backward compatibility for legacy playground/demo scenarios.
- [ ] Add end-to-end and interaction test cases for streaming, error handling, SSE disconnect, tool-calling edge cases.
- [ ] Update Storybook stories and documentation to illustrate both local/demo and full stack (service-ai) streaming chat flows.
- [ ] Remove all hacky/fake reply logic, enforce production-grade behaviors only.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Full SDUI compatibility: All configuration is schema-driven, no hardcoded endpoints.
- Streaming/interrupt errors/formats match vercel/ai best practices.
- Test coverage meets ObjectUI quality standard.
- Docs and user stories clearly demonstrate new and fallback modes.

---
See [spec#999](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/issues/999) and the latest contracts for technical details.
